> `enabled: Config.Boolean("T3CODE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED").pipe(Config.withDefault(true))`

At latest HEAD (`ca81b7b9`), `AnalyticsService.ts:156` still writes a persistent local ID to disk before checking whether telemetry is disabled, and `ingest.t3.codes` stays closed-source.

threads.subject: PR #21506 read ~/.codex & ~/.claude.json to link machines
threads.subjectZh: PR #21506 越界读取 Codex 与 Claude 凭证跨机串联身份
threads.snippet: Authored by t3dotgg, Identify.ts hashed OpenAI JWT user_id and Claude accountUuid via unsalted SHA-256 under install.owner_observed.
threads.snippetZh: 由 t3dotgg 提交：提取 OpenAI JWT 的 user_id 与 Claude accountUuid 做无盐 SHA-256 哈希（install.owner_observed），把多台机器关联到同一人。

messages.body:
Theo (@t3dotgg) merged PR #21506: `feat(server): analytics records a stable install id and who owns each install`.

`Identify.ts` read `~/.codex/auth.json` (decoding OpenAI's JWT `user_id` claim) and `~/.claude.json` (`oauthAccount.accountUuid`) alongside T3 Connect user IDs. It then computed unsalted SHA-256 digests (`telemetryId.ts`) as `install.owner_observed` to link separate machines to one person.

Because T3 stores plaintext Clerk IDs, unsalted digests reverse deterministically. External CLI file reads stayed in place for a month until PR #42299 removed them after Part 1 passed 2.26M+ views.

threads.subject: 41.6 GB fake SQLite delete & 5-second OS cmdline process scan
threads.subjectZh: 「永久删除」实为假删致库涨至 41.6 GB + 每 5 秒扫全机进程

messages.body:
Users documented two local storage and privacy defects across Issues #17845, #28903, and #11222:

1. **Fake permanent delete (#17845):** The confirmation dialog promised "This permanently clears conversation history for this thread", yet `ThreadDeletion.ts` only appended a `thread.deleted` event — bloating `statev2.sqlite` to 25.9 GB in 3 weeks and 41.6 GB in 6 weeks.
2. **5-second OS process scan (#11222 & PR #41889):** Native helper `t3-resource-monitor` ran `ProcessesToUpdate::All` with `with_cmd(UpdateKind::Always)` every 5 seconds even when diagnostics were closed, sweeping 440+ unrelated apps and games along with full command lines (which often hold plaintext API keys and passwords).

messages.body:
Even after quietly patching high-severity bugs like `ServerSecretStore` path traversal (PR #39483), T3 Code still has 0 published GitHub Security Advisories.

Line-by-line inspection of `main` HEAD (`ca81b7b9`) verified 5 active vulnerabilities:

1. **Plaintext `--lan` cookies:** 30-day shell cookies omit the `Secure` flag and allow missing-`Origin` bypass (`http.ts:215-241`, `EnvironmentAuth.ts:798-819`).
2. **Unrevocable Bearer tokens:** 30-day non-DPoP Bearer tokens cannot be self-revoked (`EnvironmentAuth.ts:1506-1521`).
3. **Replayable `?wsTicket=` URLs:** Query-string tickets carry a 5-minute replay window (`EnvironmentAuth.ts:1553-1585`).
4. **IPv6 tunnel cutoff:** `NodeNet.isIPv4` kills `::1` loopback tunnels (`startupAccess.ts:71-110`).
5. **Untrusted repo execution:** Worktrees auto-run recursive submodules and hooks with inherited host `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` and `GITHUB_TOKEN` (`GitVcsDriverCore.ts:6144-6205`).

3. **11 browsers' cookies unisolated on Desktop (`ServerBrowser.ts#L1236-L1247`):** `isolatedContext` is `true` **only** when `desktop === null` (headless Linux). On Desktop Electron—the only target that runs `BrowserImport/` (`Sources.ts`, `ChromiumKeys.ts`) to import Keychain/DPAPI/Full Disk Access cookies from 11 browsers—`isolatedContext` is `false`, `open=false` keeps the session invisible, and `preview_evaluate` runs CDP `Runtime.evaluate` (`64 KB/call`) on arbitrary URLs.
